packages.name: protobuf
packages.doc:
Package protobuf wraps google.golang.org/protobuf as a codec.Codec
implementation. It lives under third-party/codec/, in a module of its own
(ADR 0157), and is OPT-IN: a consumer blank-imports it to register the
"protobuf" Format — pkg/v1/data/codec does NOT pull it. The reason is the
schema-bound contract, not dep weight: Protobuf only encodes proto.Message
values, so it cannot honour the universal "every registered codec
round-trips any Go struct" guarantee the default registry enforces. A
non-message value surfaces PROTOBUF_MARSHAL_FAILED /
PROTOBUF_UNMARSHAL_FAILED. Non-streaming (the wire format is length-unframed;
framing is a caller concern); implements Appender. ADR 0023.

Package protobuf — range 0.3.38.* (ADR 0023 third-party/codec/protobuf block).

Package protobuf — declares the sentinel *errs.Error values for Protobuf.

symbols.name: CodeProtobufMarshalFailed
symbols.doc:
CodeProtobufMarshalFailed identifies a Marshal failure — either the value is
not a proto.Message (Protobuf is schema-bound) or google.golang.org/protobuf
/proto.Marshal returned an error.

symbols.name: CodeProtobufSizeExceeded
symbols.doc:
CodeProtobufSizeExceeded identifies an Unmarshal input over the 10 MiB cap
(CWE-400 defence before the decoder allocates).

symbols.name: CodeProtobufUnmarshalFailed
symbols.doc:
CodeProtobufUnmarshalFailed identifies an Unmarshal failure — the target is
not a proto.Message, or proto.Unmarshal rejected the wire bytes.

symbols.name: Codec
symbols.doc: Codec is the registered Protobuf singleton.

symbols.name: MarshalFailed
symbols.doc: MarshalFailed wraps a non-proto.Message value or a proto.Marshal failure.

symbols.name: New
symbols.doc: New returns the Protobuf codec singleton.

symbols.name: SizeExceeded
symbols.doc: SizeExceeded marks an Unmarshal input over the 10 MiB hard cap.

symbols.name: UnmarshalFailed
symbols.doc: UnmarshalFailed wraps a non-proto.Message target or a proto.Unmarshal failure.
